page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes in the left margin (Jacob. 1.17 and Prov. 8.15 references). Page number 8 at the head. Running head: an ornamental rule with the title "PANEGYRIS I." above the main heading.

main_text.head: SACRO NVPTIALI FLORENTISSIMI ET POTENTISSIMI PRINCIPIS Dn. Friderici IV. Electoris, Comitis Palatini, domini sui clementiss. ante hoc tempus dicata & consecrata, ipsiusque Celf. oblata ipsa nuptiarum festivitate in illustri aula Dillenbergensi:
main_text.p: Jacob.1.17. Prov.8.15.NCredilis admiratio virtutum plane heroicarum, Princeps Elector, domine clementiss. quibus ex singulari gratia T. Celsitudinem pra caeteris tui ordinis insignite ornavit is, a quo omnis bona donatio provenit, & per quem reges regnant, principesque justa decernunt, me quoque eo pertraxit, ut inter caeteros numero non paucos neque autoritate leves, ipse etiam gratulator prodire non erubescam, minime veritus impudentiae temeritatisve notam.

Sic enim libuit palam contestari animi mei gaudium ex praclara hac de te opinione conceptum, ut quisquam te non tuis solum subditis, sed nobis quoque omnibus, immo toti Christi Ecclesiae maximo bono divinitus concessum, cujus sub umbra gratam quietem captet, & suavissimam illam verbi divini auram hauriat. Est profecto sic natura compa-ratum,

page.notes: Left-margin references "Jacob.1.17." and "Prov.8.15." beside the first paragraph. Title page top is a decorative rule. Heavy show-through and damage at the right edge; the final word "paratum," is partly cut at the edge. The large initial N is a woodcut initial.
